propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 section before Phase 1 that searches the tracker for duplicates and establishes the reported-against version floor
The tracker search must span all ticket statuses including closed tickets (759 of 764 bug tickets are closed), not just open tickets

The reported-against version floor must be derived from either explicit rebar/commit version in the report text or converted from the ticket's created_at nanosecond timestamp using division by 1000000000 and @<unix-seconds> format for git rev-list --before
Step 0 must confirm the current worktree HEAD matches origin/main before proceeding
The Step-0 duplicates link writeback must be added to the pre-approved carve-out list in the approval gate section to avoid gating an action the same file prescribes
A new unit test must verify Step 0 exists before Phase 1, includes all three actions, spells out the nanosecond conversion explicitly, and references the unknown-version case
